name: ISCTM 2026 Autumn Conference
organizer: International Society for CNS Clinical Trials and Methodology
description: The ISCTM 2026 Autumn Conference meets September 16 to 17, 2026, at the Westin Philadelphia. Sessions cover biomarkers, novel endpoints in mood and psychosis trials, neuromodulation and digital health technologies; poster submissions closed June 18, 2026.

sources.note: Dates September 16 to 17, 2026, Philadelphia, poster deadline June 18, 2026
Venue The Westin Philadelphia, 99 South 17th Street; speaker deadlines
Home page listing of upcoming meetings and award deadlines

notes: The meeting registration site (isctmautumn.societyconference.com) is JavaScript rendered; registration deadlines were not visible.

name: ISCTM 2027 Autumn Conference (joint day with ECNP)

description: ISCTM lists a 2027 Autumn Conference for September 23 to 25, 2027, in Barcelona, including a joint day with ECNP ahead of the 40th ECNP Congress. No deadlines have been published.
